{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"duration_ms":615093,"duration_api_ms":616305,"num_turns":2,"result":"Walking through the diff carefully before committing to comments:

**Key observations:**
- `createLabel` now takes `element` as its first argument and delegates to `createText`, which appends the element to the parent itself—callers no longer need to call `.appendChild()`.
- Several callers still do a manual `.appendChild()` after calling `createLabel`, which in some cases moves the already-inserted element to a different parent (deliberate) and in others is now a no-op (if the same parent was passed).
- `getClusterTitleWidth` in `rendering-util/rendering-elements/clusters.js` does not `await` `createLabel`—the explore agent confirmed this function exists there and is never called anywhere (dead code), but the bug is real.
- `startLabelRight` in both `dagre-wrapper/edges.js` and `rendering-elements/edges.js` passes the outer group as parent to `createLabel`, while every other terminal label passes `inner` directly—pre-existing inconsistency, but now more visible because the parent argument is semantically meaningful.
- `nonMarkdownToLines` splits words by `/\s/g`—consecutive whitespace produces empty-string tokens.
- The `title-row`/`row` CSS class is now applied to `<text>` instead of individual `<tspan>` elements—confirmed by the explore agent that no CSS actually targets these classes, so the risk is low but it's still a structural deviation from the old implementation.
- `!images` is dead code in `configureLabelImages`.
- `getConfig()` is called twice in the same ternary in `configureLabelImages`.
- `maxSafeSizeForWidth = 16384` needs a better comment explaining the browser constraint it guards against.
